claims.head: Ottawa gets to the dangerous areas
claims.call: Ottawa needs no more than its usual 14.8 unblocked shots per expected goal.
claims.body: Ottawa ranks 3rd of 32 for shot quality (one expected goal for every 14.8 unblocked shots); Detroit ranks 25th for keeping shots to the outside.

DET.head: Close, but Ottawa has the slight edge
DET.body: Ottawa has controlled the play far better over recent games, Ottawa is playing for the second night in a row, and Detroit has home ice. Detroit can tip it if it keeps shots to a minimum.

OTT.head: Leaning Ottawa’s way
OTT.body: Ottawa has controlled the play far better over recent games, Ottawa is playing for the second night in a row, and Detroit has home ice. Detroit can still swing it if it keeps shots to a minimum.
